craft_notes: Sthāyin: utkrānti unit 54. Sanskrit-first kept. Rows: 2. Close: rest. Rejected: smoothing — killed: flagged. Read aloud: steady cadence.

lines: Thus this immediate-departure hinted in Mālinī-doctrine: himself or by
the guru or then as to be performed by the Great Lord.
l4.sanskrit_cite: itīyaṃ sadya+utkrāntiḥ sūcitā mālinīmate svayaṃ vā guruṇā vātha kāryatvena maheśinā
